components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: Signature high-intent action button (e.g. 'Schedule Consultation') — gradient fire fill, shimmer sweep, colored glow shadow, nudging arrow icon.
components.css: .ds-cta-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E11417, rgba(225,20,23,0.85)); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(225,20,23,0.3), 0 4px 12px rgba(225,20,23,0.2); transition: box-shadow 300ms ease-out; } .ds-cta-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(225,20,23,0.35), 0 6px 16px rgba(225,20,23,0.25); transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); } .ds-cta-shimmer { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 50%, transparent 100%); background-size: 1000px 100%; animation: ds-shimmer 3s infinite; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { 0% { background-position: -1000px 0; } 100% { background-position: 1000px 0; } } .ds-cta-arrow { display: inline-block; animation: ds-nudge 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-nudge { 0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); } 50% { transform: translateX(3px); } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Navy-filled secondary action button (shadcn Button, secondary variant).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; background: #2B348C; border: 1px solid #1E2670; transition: filter 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard rounded card used for Why-Choose-Us, Team, and Testimonial sections — hover lift + shadow growth.

components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(218,221,230,0.7); background: #FFFFFF; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,0.08), 0 1px 0 rgba(16,24,40,0.06); transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(16,24,40,0.18); border-color: #DADDE6; } .ds-card-quote { font-size: 16px; color: #181A26; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-card-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: #181A26; } .ds-card-role { font-size: 14px; color: #606676; }

components.name: Nav Link (active)
components.description: Primary nav link with the centered navy underline pill marking the active route.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(24,26,38,0.8); transition: all 200ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #181A26; background: #EFF1F5; } .ds-nav-underline { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); height: 2px; width: 32px; background: #2B348C; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview: A well-appointed, modern practice, not a courtroom drama. Institutional Navy grounds the space with quiet authority; Firebrick Red is reserved for the moments that call for action — a button, a link underline, a stat icon — never spread across a whole surface. Depth comes from soft, layered shadows that respond to touch (cards lift on hover, the primary CTA's glow intensifies) rather than flat SaaS minimalism or heavy, dated skeuomorphism. Fraunces serif headlines against IBM Plex Sans body copy give it a considered, editorial weight without tipping into old-fashioned "gavel and scales" law-firm cliché — which this system explicitly rejects, along with generic AI-template tells (gradient text, eyebrow kickers on every section, identical icon-tile grids) and an overly formal, bureaucratic tone.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-authority, red-action: two brand hues with clearly separated jobs, not a blended palette.
Soft ambient depth: an eight-step shadow scale used for hover response, not static decoration.
Serif display type, sans body: Fraunces carries every heading site-wide; IBM Plex Sans carries everything else.
Two radius systems by surface role: tight radii (3-9px) on form controls, generous radii (16-24px) on cards and sections.
Glass/backdrop-blur is a rare accent (hero stat chips only), never a default surface treatment.

rules.name: The Two-Job Rule
rules.body: Navy and red never trade places. Navy = authority/structure. Red = action. If a red element isn't asking for a click, it's used wrong.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is a heading-only instrument. It never appears in body copy, form controls, or nav.

rules.name: The Response, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: No card ships at shadow-lg or above by default. Heavy shadows are earned by interaction, never a resting state.

dos: Do keep Firebrick Red to action moments only — buttons, links, focus rings, the nav active-underline.
Do give every card a resting shadow-sm and let shadow-lg + lift be the hover reward, never the default.
Do set every heading in Fraunces, bold, tight tracking.
Do reserve glass/backdrop-blur treatments for floating elements over imagery.
Do write testimonials, service descriptions, and team bios in specific, concrete language.
donts: Don't use gradient-clipped text on headings — SectionHeading's current gradient-fill H2 is legacy; treat solid foreground color as standard going forward.
Don't default to stock gavel-and-scales imagery, navy-and-gold trust templates, or wall-of-text about pages.
Don't add a tiny uppercase eyebrow kicker above every section as generic scaffolding.
Don't mix the two radius systems on one element.
Don't let the tone tip formal or bureaucratic.
